in_sanskrit.name: Ishanya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Time, Ishana
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ishanya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ishanya is a name derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Ishana’ which signifies the deity of time and the beginning. This name holds immense significance in Hindu mythology, symbolizing the supreme power, creation, and the start of new beginnings. Ishanya is believed to be the embodiment of time, and those named after her are considered to possess the qualities of wisdom, patience, and understanding.
